properties.name: picsure.ai.max-tool-iterations
properties.description: Hard cap on tool-call round-trips per chat turn. Hitting it returns the best answer so far, prose only, never an error. Maps from the AI_MAX_TOOL_ITERATIONS environment variable.

properties.name: picsure.ai.model.http.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the HTTP Converse endpoint ConverseHttpModelClient posts to ({base}/model/{modelId}/converse). Required when picsure.ai.model.provider=http; startup fails when blank.

properties.name: picsure.ai.model.http.api-token
properties.description: Bearer token ConverseHttpModelClient sends in the Authorization header. Required when picsure.ai.model.provider=http; startup fails when blank.

properties.name: picsure.ai.model.http.model-id
properties.description: Model id ConverseHttpModelClient puts in the request path. Required when picsure.ai.model.provider=http; startup fails when blank.
